title: Mobile UI canary: MoneyText single-announcement semantics guardrail
body:
## Context

Narrow fresh-implementation canary under #301, #372, and #800.

This slice validates the repaired auto-runner commit-before-review path on a tiny shared mobile accessibility hardening change. Merging this issue does not close #301, #372, or #800.

No Figma/reference gate is required because this changes accessibility semantics only and must not alter visual rendering.

## Planning metadata

- Work type: hardening
- Area: Mobile UI / accessibility
- Day scope: Day 1
- Validation class: mobile-ui
- Initial MD estimate: XS = 0.25 MD
- Estimate confidence: High
- Parent/trackers: #301, #372, #800

## Scope

- Harden `MoneyText` so assistive technology receives exactly one amount/currency announcement.
- Preserve the current visible amount/currency text, normalization, tabular figures, alignment, max-lines, and overflow behavior.
- The default semantic label must remain the normalized visible amount/currency text.
- A supplied `semanticLabel` must override the default announcement.
- Exclude the visible child text from producing a duplicate semantic announcement.
- Add focused widget tests for default, custom-label, blank amount, and blank currency behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

- `MoneyText` exposes exactly one semantics node carrying its effective accessible label.
- Default accessible text matches the normalized display amount and currency.
- Custom `semanticLabel` is announced instead of the default.
- Blank amount and currency preserve current display fallbacks.
- No duplicate amount/currency semantic announcement exists.
- Visible rendering and existing component behavior remain unchanged.
- The fixed mobile low-risk validation profile passes.

## Non-goals

- No money parsing, arithmetic, rounding, currency conversion, formatting-policy, API, domain, persistence, auth, storage, settlement, payment, bill calculation, schema, OpenAPI, generated-client, navigation, visual redesign, theme, Docker, CI, deployment, env, release, provider, systemd, stale-claim, follow-up issue, or review-fix work.
- Do not change any file outside the two contracted mobile UI files.
